basic_details.scholarship_name: Rhodes Scholarship for Pakistan (University of Oxford, UK)
basic_details.major_restrictions: Eligible for almost all full-time postgraduate degrees offered by the University of Oxford (BSc, BA, MSc, MSt, MPhil, BCL, DPhil / PhD). Ineligible courses include part-time courses and standalone 1-year PGCert.
basic_details.number_of_awards_total: ~100 Rhodes Scholars elected globally each year
basic_details.number_of_awards_pakistan: 1 single scholar elected exclusively from Pakistan per year
basic_details.duration_of_scholarship: 2 years baseline tenure (extensible up to 3 or 4 years for DPhil / PhD researchers)

eligibility_requirements.age_limit_notes: Must be aged 18-23 on 1 October of application year; OR up to age 26 if completed first degree within the past 2 years.
eligibility_requirements.academic_qualifications: Completed undergraduate degree (First Class Honours or GPA 3.70+/4.00) that satisfies entry requirements of Oxford postgraduate programs.
eligibility_requirements.grading_conversion_notes: First Class Honours equivalent; in Pakistani CGPA scale, minimum 3.70 / 4.00, or top 5% of graduating class.
eligibility_requirements.subject_background_prerequisites: Any academic discipline offered at Oxford.
eligibility_requirements.current_education_status: Must have completed first undergraduate degree by July preceding arrival in Oxford.
eligibility_requirements.graduation_year_restrictions: Graduation within the past 2-3 years for older cohort pathway.
eligibility_requirements.work_experience_notes: Not mandatory; extraordinary leadership, community impact, athletics, or social advocacy is prioritized.
eligibility_requirements.language_notes: Must satisfy Oxford University Higher Level English requirements (IELTS 7.5 with 7.0 in each band, or TOEFL iBT 110).
eligibility_requirements.special_eligibility_categories: Must have resided in Pakistan for at least 4 of the last 10 years and received formal education in Pakistan.

tuition_fee.details: Full University of Oxford tuition fees and College fees paid directly.

admission_application_fee.details: Rhodes Trust covers Oxford postgraduate application fee code.

accommodation.details: Covered via tax-free living stipend for Oxford college or private accommodation.

airfare.details: Two economy class flights (one at start of scholarship to the UK, and one at the end of tenure returning home).

visa_fee.details: UK Student Route visa application fee and International Health Surcharge (IHS) fully paid.

health_insurance.details: Full coverage under the UK National Health Service (NHS) via IHS coverage.

books_and_materials_allowance.details: Rhodes Research and Travel Grants available up to £1,000 upon application to Rhodes House.

research_funding_conference_grant.details: Access to Rhodes House conference travel funds and academic development grants.

travel_transit_allowance.details: Settling-in allowance upon arrival in Oxford (£250–£500).

university_and_program_options.single_or_multiple_universities: Single University: University of Oxford only.
participating_institutions: University of Oxford (All colleges: Balliol, Magdalen, Christ Church, St John's, etc.)
university_and_program_options.university_rankings_scope: World #1 (Times Higher Education World University Rankings).
available_majors: All disciplines (Philosophy, Politics and Economics, Law, Public Policy, Computer Science, Quantum Physics, Oncology, Literature, History)
university_and_program_options.program_duration: 2 to 3 years (up to 4 years for DPhil)
university_and_program_options.admission_requirements_summary: Oxford departmental admissions criteria (transcripts, writing samples, high GRE/test scores where required, references).
university_and_program_options.easiest_hardest_institutions_guidance: Election to the Rhodes Scholarship does NOT automatically guarantee admission to the chosen Oxford course; the scholar must secure Oxford department admission in December/January following election.
university_and_program_options.strategic_program_match_advice: Consult Oxford course directory closely; show how Oxford's specific faculty members align with your intellectual mission.

application_process_roadmap.portal_system_name: Rhodes Trust Embark / Slate Application Portal
application_process_roadmap.account_creation_instructions: Register on the Rhodes Trust portal selecting the Pakistan constituency between June and August.
step_by_step_workflow: 1. Register on Rhodes Trust portal (constituency: Pakistan).
2. Upload transcripts, birth certificate/passport, and proof of education in Pakistan.
3. Write Personal Statement (1,000 words maximum) adhering strictly to the honesty and authorship pledge.
4. Write Academic Statement of Study (350 words maximum) explaining proposed Oxford courses.
5. Register 5 to 6 referees (at least 3 must be academic).
6. Submit online application by early August deadline.
7. National Selection Committee in Pakistan reviews dossiers and shortlists 8-12 finalists.
8. In-person social reception and high-level interview in Islamabad (October/November).
9. Single Rhodes Scholar elected on the evening of the interview.
10. Elected scholar applies to University of Oxford graduate admissions (December - January).
application_process_roadmap.university_vs_scholarship_routing: Scholarship first: Compete for Rhodes election; elected scholar applies to Oxford department with guaranteed Rhodes funding backing.
application_process_roadmap.recommendation_letters_submission_method: Direct secure electronic submission by 5 to 6 referees via confidential email links.
application_process_roadmap.personal_statement_prompts: 1,000-word essay addressing: Who are you? What drives you? How do you hope to fight the world's fight? Must be 100% unassisted work (no feedback or AI generation permitted).
application_process_roadmap.study_plan_research_proposal_requirement: 350-word Academic Statement justifying primary and secondary course choices at Oxford.
application_process_roadmap.cv_format_requirements: Concise 2-page CV outlining academic record, awards, athletics, volunteerism, and publications.
application_process_roadmap.interview_format_details: Legendary in-person final interview in Islamabad before a national committee chaired by a Supreme Court Justice or distinguished leader.
application_process_roadmap.standardized_tests: Oxford department may require GRE for Economics or Computer Science.
application_process_roadmap.attestation_requirements: HEC degree attestation required for Oxford postgraduate matriculation.
application_process_roadmap.translation_requirements: Certified English translations for any non-English documents.
application_process_roadmap.final_submission_method: 100% online portal submission to Rhodes Trust.

required_documents_checklist.pakistan_specific_instruction: Demonstrate knowledge of Oxford faculty and colleges

important_dates_timeline.interview_period: Late October / Early November in Islamabad
important_dates_timeline.final_result_acceptance_deadline: Day of final interview in November
important_dates_timeline.annual_cycle_notes: Only ONE award available for all of Pakistan annually; requires supreme intellectual and ethical distinction.

selection_process_and_weights.extracurricular_and_leadership_weight: 25% (Energy to use one's talents to the full; physical vigour, athletics, debate, public impact)
selection_process_and_weights.personal_statement_weight: 15% (Authenticity, moral force of character, instinct to lead)
selection_process_and_weights.interview_weight: 10% (Final interview decides the single winner among the 8-12 finalists)
selection_process_and_weights.selection_panel_composition: Chaired by high-profile Pakistani figures (former judges, Rhodes alumni, vice chancellors, senior ambassadors).
selection_process_and_weights.evaluation_methodology: Evaluation against the four core criteria of Cecil Rhodes' will: 1) Literary & scholastic attainments, 2) Energy to use one's talents to the full, 3) Truth, courage, devotion to duty, sympathy for the weak, 4) Moral force of character and instincts to lead.

competitiveness_profile.acceptance_rate_pakistan: ~0.1% to 0.2% (The Most Selective Postgraduate Award in Pakistan)
competitiveness_profile.typical_academic_and_research_profile: Valedictorian / Gold Medalist, national debate champion or collegiate athlete, founder of prominent social initiative.
competitiveness_profile.common_backgrounds_of_winners: Graduates of LUMS, AKU, NUST, Oxford/Cambridge first-degree holders, or top provincial universities.

fake_websites_and_scams: Anyone offering 'coaching' or 'reviewing' Rhodes personal statements for a fee is violating Rhodes Trust rules. Outside assistance on personal statements is explicitly grounds for disqualification.
red_flags_and_warnings.application_fee_warning: Rhodes Trust never charges any application or registration fee.
red_flags_and_warnings.agent_and_intermediary_warnings: Use of agents or consultants is grounds for immediate lifetime disqualification.
hidden_costs_breakdown: Domestic travel to Islamabad for the finalist dinner and in-person interviews.
Oxford graduate application fee (£75 per course) if fee waiver code is delayed.
misleading_claims_debunked: MYTH: You must be an elite athlete. (Fact: 'Energy to use talents to the full' can be demonstrated through rigorous debate, performing arts, mountaineering, or community organizing, not just varsity sports).
official_vs_unofficial_discrepancies: Third-party sites often list outdated age requirements; the Rhodes Trust updated its age criteria to accommodate 24-26 year olds who finished degrees later.

scholarship_obligations_and_terms.minimum_gpa_maintenance: Must maintain good standing and satisfy Oxford supervisory progress milestones.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.attendance_requirements: Must reside in Oxford during full academic terms (Michaelmas, Hilary, Trinity).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.academic_progress_monitoring: Termly reports from Oxford college and department tutors submitted to Rhodes House.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.work_restrictions_during_study: Scholars may undertake limited teaching or research assistantships as permitted by Oxford and UK visa regulations.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.home_country_return_obligation: No statutory legal return obligation (unlike Fulbright or Chevening); however, scholars are morally called to 'fight the world's fight'.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.repayment_clawback_conditions: Revocation and expulsion in cases of gross academic fraud, disciplinary expulsion from Oxford, or criminal convictions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_university: Strictly disallowed (tenable only at the University of Oxford).
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.rules_for_changing_major: Changing Oxford degree course requires prior written approval from the Warden of Rhodes House and Oxford graduate admissions.
scholarship_obligations_and_terms.extension_policy: Third year of funding can be approved for DPhil students upon satisfactory research progress.
